subject: general
question:
M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only two people sit between P and O when counted from the left of O. W sits third to the left of N. Y sits to the immediate right of N. Y sits second to the left of P. X is not an immediate neighbour of W. Who sits third to the right of M?
solution:
Given: M, N, O, P, W, X and Y sit around a circular table facing the centre.

Only two people sit between P and O when counted from the left of O.

W sits third to the left of N.

Y sits to the immediate right of N.

Y sits second to the left of P.

X is not an immediate neighbour of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbe8b37ff25639ef9190c9b95a7caab99ad3f6232bb86f022780c1f0220618b4.png] 

So, Y sits third to the right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
